record.scope: native03 frozen source and existing outputs only; CPU affinity 1 and dense-library threads 1; no model or checkpoint load; no inference, download, candidate alteration or new attempt
confirmed: The frozen native source for parsing, indexing, atom constants, frame construction, reconstruction, writer and model decode is byte-identical to pinned upstream; the inference entrypoint only changes the requested seed.

Existing LMDB stores preprocessed input coordinates, not sampled intermediate frames. Its parsed receptor-then-peptide order, generation mask, preserved chain/residue identifiers, x reflection and shared peptide-centroid translation are directly checked.

Native gt.pdb retains original input sequences and coordinates within PDB rounding after the shared translation; each candidate receptor matches gt coordinates and protein atom keys excluding native-omitted OXT.

All 12 candidate binder residue identifiers retain input order and chain binding. Output local N/CA/C/CB geometry matches native rigid-group constants after undoing x reflection; defects are primarily between residue frames, including inter-residue C-N distances.

The native reconstruction applies each residue frame independently (R @ local_atom + t) and does not impose an inter-residue peptide bond closure constraint. Native angle_purify only masks unavailable torsion angles; it is not a bond-length repair step.
ruled_out_within_scope: An adapter coordinate/chain/sequence reordering operation after native output: no such coordinate operation occurs; raw native files are QC inputs.
Wrong-chain adjacency or insertion-code pairing for these inputs: all binder identifiers are complete, unchanged and contiguous in native res_nb.
A single global mirror or translation as the source of shortened distances: both preserve pairwise distances; observed target/gt coordinates verify those transformations.
A global 10-fold PDB unit error: local backbone bond lengths retain native Angstrom constants, and source decode converts Angstrom to nm and back symmetrically.
A basic N/CA/C/CB atom-name table mismatch for the observed outputs: measured local coordinates agree with the source residue-specific constants.
unknown: The sampled trans/rotmats/angles tensors were not serialized by the native entrypoint; only final PDB, ground truth and statistics survive. Thus the exact sampled-frame-to-output numerical path cannot be fully replayed from raw evidence.

The precise causal source of the incompatible inter-residue frames remains unknown; these observations do not distinguish model predictions, native sampling behavior, training/input effects or an unobserved native numerical issue. No model root cause is asserted.
A broader latent-frame or scientific-method limitation cannot be excluded by a read-only inspection of these 12 outputs.
record.decision: No confirmed adapter/reconstruction misalignment was found that can be repaired within existing evidence. Retain quality_not_met as an observed native-output geometry result, without assigning model root cause. Three attempts remain exhausted. Stop and remain quiescent.
